name: escanner-agent-kit
description: A review loop for Claude Code that terminates: closed rule vocabulary, deterministic validators, a precision filter, delta re-reviews — plus a spec-to-ship pipeline and a reference Flutter + native agent stack.

plugins.name: review-loop
plugins.description: Rule-ID-gated code review: the review-filter agent, rule validators, a destructive-git safety hook, project templates, and /review-loop:review.

plugins.name: dev-pipeline
plugins.description: Spec → validate → decompose → implement, checkpointed in execution_state.md, with convergence rules so the coder/reviewer loop ends.

plugins.name: flutter-native-agents
plugins.description: Reference agents for Flutter apps with a native (C/C++) engine and iOS/Android platform code: coders, area reviewers, contract owner, security and performance gates.
